Install a raised pedestrian crossing with tactile paving to provide a safe crossing point for pedestrians on this urban street.
Install a signalised pedestrian crossing with pedestrian refuge island to ensure safe crossing access for pedestrians in this urban area.
Add a pedestrian refuge island at the signalised crossing to provide a safe waiting area for pedestrians before crossing the road.
Install dropped kerbs at the crossing to enable wheelchair and mobility scooter users to access the footway safely.
Install street lighting along the urban road to enhance visibility for both pedestrians and drivers, improving safety at night and during low-light conditions.
